visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with styled dark hair, wearing a professional pink blazer over a white shirt and a gold necklace, stands in front of a TV screen displaying news articles. She holds a red pointer and speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements. (2) She lifts a large white board containing a printed table titled 'Insult Fine Table' with 'Freedom Times' branding. She points at specific rows while looking at the camera. (3) She lowers the board and picks up a blank white square card, gesturing with it as she continues speaking in the studio setting. (4) The card now displays the red text '醜八怪！' (Ugly Person). She holds it while a stylized filter with sparkles and soft lighting appears around her. (5) She begins an energetic, rhythmic dance, moving her torso and arms while holding the 'Ugly Person' card. Her image is duplicated into three layers with varying transparency to create a motion-blur effect against the studio background.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A professional-looking woman in a pink blazer, white blouse, and gold chain necklace, with dark hair styled with volume.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A news studio setting with a large monitor displaying news clippings and articles behind the subject. A desk with stacks of papers is in the foreground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Clear female professional voice begins speaking at a fast pace with high enthusiasm. Low-volume synth-pop music plays in the background with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A sharp percussive 'ding' sound effect triggers as text graphics appear on screen. The vocal intensity remains high. (3) A loud, low-frequency 'beep' sound censors a word, followed immediately by a 'whoosh' transition effect. (4) Another percussive 'hit' sound as a board is raised. The female vocal pause for a second, then delivers a punchline with rising intonation. (5) A high-energy J-pop female vocal track with bright synth melodies and heavy percussion swells in volume. The main speaker shouts 'Chou-ba-guai!' over the beat, matching the rhythmic energy of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Informative Premise -> Legal Fact Injection -> Absurdist Pivot -> Rhythmic Performance
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a viral comedy clip that parodies serious news reporting while educating viewers about online insult laws, ending with a humorous and energetic dance performance of a common internet insult.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density text overlays and synchronized sound effects typical of social-media native short-form content. The shift from news parody to dance meme is a classic engagement tactic.
